subject: AWESOME Photos!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I love that top one! Nice going Cube!! 📷

Xandu has taken some good ones too, I hope he shares them here soon... or maybe on our BurnoutAholics Flickr...

I hope more people get into this feature too, as it is really nice to see the shots racers take themselves. They are often better then the official screenshots!
